entities.summary: Jean-Luc Crucke is a Belgian politician of Les Engagés who has been serving as the Minister of Mobility and Climate in the De Wever Government since February 2025. He previously was a member of the Chamber of Representatives from 2024 until 2015, having previously served from 2007 to 2009. From 2017 to 2022, he was a minister in the government of Wallonia. Until 2023, he was a member of the Reformist Movement.
